headline: Mikel Arteta, Michael Carrick and the time and zeal managers need to drag a club back to the top
body: Mikel Arteta has become a reference point. Like Alex Ferguson and Jurgen Klopp before him, he has become proof that coaches should be judged after years, not months. The problem is that this sells those particular managers short. These are exceptional cases, not the norm. Michael Carrick is now under scrutiny at Manchester United. Such scepticism might seem harsh when compared to Arsenal and Arteta. But what Arteta proves it that it takes a certain force of personality to drag a club out of the doldrums and keep dragging it upwards.   submitted by   /u/TheAthletic [link]   [comments]
